name: IP Range Expander
description: Convert between CIDR blocks and address ranges, and expand a block into an address list.

hints.mode: Converting addresses to CIDR yields the minimal set of blocks covering the range.
hints.output: Expansion enumerates every address, so a large block would exhaust resources; a count limit applies.
hints.limit: Upper limit for expanded addresses; anything beyond it is truncated.

faq.a: Only IPv4 is supported at the moment.
When the count exceeds the limit the run stops and is flagged as truncated to protect memory and response size.
